reviews.name: Amy Rivera
reviews.text: Just got back from the Amalfi trip and WHAT A DREAM not just bc of the beautiful places we got to see but for the people I met, true friendships were formed and our leaders Sam Nikki Carrie and Adam were just amazing always looking out for us but also vibing with us and hiping us up the hole time probably see you in Nicaragua on NYE

reviews.name: Lindsey Baumann
reviews.text: My husband and I went on the Nicaragua NYE trip and had an absolute blast. I knew when signing up that SYB guests are typically single travelers so I was a little unsure on how we would be received overall by the group. We're in our mid 30s, with no kids and running out of fellow childless friends to travel with - IYKYK. Everyone was SO NICE and we made friends right away and had an absolute blast. You could pack in your days with non stop activities or take it slow and chill in the pool. It was the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation. The waves in Nica are a dream for beginner surfers. The amazing people and leaders in our group were the absolute highlight of our travels and something you just don't get when traveling alone or as a couple. We will definitely be booking more SYB trips in the future - hopefully a ski trip!

reviews.name: Ely Goldberg
reviews.text:
I have now been on two incredible Surf Yoga Beer trips and all I can say is wow! Just spent a week in Belize in December, and I’m still riding the high from it and have already booked my next trip. I’ve traveled a lot, but these trips feel different in the best way; more connected, more intentional, and honestly more fun than I expected. Both Belize and my NYE last year in Nicaragua were both 10/10!!

What stood out most wasn’t just the beautiful beaches or the balance of planned activities, but the people. On both trips the group energy was unreal. Everyone showed up open, supportive, and ready to make the most of every moment. By the end of the week, it felt like we’d known each other forever.

The leaders also deserve a huge shoutout, Mantas, Steph, Courtney, Sam, Eli, Duncan, Allison, Sav, Shriner and Matas and so many more across both trips. They set the tone from day one: warm, organized, and genuinely invested in making sure every single person had an amazing experience. They’re the kind of people who make you want to show up as your best self.

Every day had its own magic, whether it was sunrise workouts, exploring Caye Caulker, standing up on a surfboard for the first time ever, or laughing over dinner after a full day of adventure. And, of course, the big highlight each trip were the multiple boat days!!

If you’re thinking about booking a Surf Yoga Beer trip, just do it. The destinations are incredible, but it’s the community and the leadership that make it unforgettable. I left feeling inspired, recharged, and genuinely grateful for all the people I met.

reviews.name: Mitchell Nunis
reviews.text:
Believe the hype, Surf Yoga Beer is absolutely the real deal.

I just returned from their Nicaraguan NYE tour and it's genuinely one of my favourite weeks of my life. As the only Australian in the group, I walked in wondering if I'd find my people. I did, instantly. From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and genuinely connected; not just to the team, but to everyone around me.

What makes SYB so special is the heart behind it. The leadership is genuinely enthusiastic about creating moments that matter, and that energy is infectious. They took 50 strangers and somehow turned us into people who've shared something truly profound together. The activities (disco night, karaoke, the boat party, the NYE white party) weren't just fun; they became the backdrop for real human connection.

And then there are the little touches that make all the difference. Having two professional photographers meant we could actually be present, actually live in the moment without our phones getting in the way. We got to just be there together, and they captured it all so we could relive it later.

I've walked away with friendships from this trip that feel like they'll genuinely last. There was laughter, there were tears, there was joy, and plenty of dancing. But mostly, there was this feeling of being seen, welcomed, and part of something bigger than myself.

If you're on the fence, jump in. I'm already planning my next trip.

reviews.name: Kelly Bly
reviews.text: This may have been the best week of my life, still swimming in the dream of it all. I cannot say enough amazing things about SYB, from the moment I arrived I felt safe and welcomed with so many hugs to the sad tears upon leaving just a few short days later. SYB is so much more than a group travel trip, a yoga retreat or a NYE party, it’s truly one in its own category. I was taught to surf from amazing supportive instructors, got to practice yoga in the most perfect yoga shala overlooking the ocean, and celebrate friendships over lots of booze with some of the most amazing souls that I now consider family. I can’t wait for more SYB trips in the future! I’d highly recommend to anyone even remotely considering, this is a full send, don’t hold back moment. Don’t think just do!🧡

reviews.name: Susie McKeon
reviews.text:
Don’t think. Just book.

I booked the NYE Nicaragua trip, and it quite possibly changed my life. From the moment you arrive on day one, everything is planned for you 100%. All you have to do is show up, literally and metaphorically. The workouts are fun and intense but totally doable for a generally active person, and somehow everyone on the trip immediately feels like a future lifelong friend.

Yes, it can get a little “woo woo” at times, but if you lean into the spirituality, you’ll get exactly what you’re meant to get out of it. The trip leaders are incredibly fun, warm, and genuinely invested in making sure you have the best experience possible. Fair warning: it’s an introvert’s worst nightmare - nonstop from 7 a.m. until midnight and beyond - but again… LEAN IN.

Highly, highly recommend. Already saving up for my next trip.

reviews.name: James Breen
reviews.text:
If you value experiences and connection over basic luxury in your travels, Surf Yoga Beer could be for you. I had an incredible time in Nicaragua over New Years with a good combination of surfing, fitness, thoughtful reflection, and social activities. The instructors were all great people who go above and beyond to make sure everyone is having fun.

If you’re on the fence, choose courage before comfort and take the leap. Everyone’s different, but would be surprised if you don’t come back with gratitude for an unforgettable  adventure.

reviews.name: Lukas
reviews.text:
This New Year’s trip with SYB in Nicaragua was truly something special. Every day was thoughtfully planned with a variety of options that catered to everyone’s different wants and needs. Even with a huge group of 52 people, the experience felt incredibly personal. We were all engaged, connected, and able to build friendships.

The week itself was nothing short of amazing with relaxation on the beach, partying on boats, cruising through town, and fully immersing ourselves in the beauty and culture of Nicaragua. Everyone came with intention - celebrate life, embrace new experiences, and share meaningful moments with new friends along the way.

From what started as a spontaneous SYB run on Venice Beach, California and then ending up at a full scale group adventure in Nicaragua, this trip is truly one for the books and I can’t think of a better way to reconnect with what life has to offer than by taking a journey like this.

reviews.name: HIROKI
reviews.text:
I jumped on the SYB NYE trip to Nicaragua, (my first SYB trip ever), and wow, it was nothing like a normal vacation!

Every day was workouts, surfing, and parties with 50 super high energy members. The leaders, especially Mantas, were always checking in and making sure we were vibing, which made the whole thing feel so easy and welcoming.

It was my first time in Nicaragua too, and honestly everything went smooth. No weird moments, no stress and just good times… except for getting several mosquitoes bites.

Already hyped for the next one!

reviews.name: Steve Borodin
reviews.text:
I have done two trips now with SYB, Nicaragua NYE and Croatia.  My first one on NYE was intended to be a one time deal, until I saw the caliber of experience put together by the team.  Everything from the lodging, to the location, the food, the social scene, the cultural scene, and the unbelievable boat days put this travel company head and shoulders above the rest.

Every day is plotted out for you with the perfect balance of local area exploration, fitness, mindfulness, and partying.  Whether you come alone or with a friend, you’ll meet dozens of people from all walks of life.  Everyone brings something to the table to make that trip one of the most memorable experiences of your life.

From the cliffside yoga platform in Nicaragua to the legitimate PIRATE SHIP you’ll sail through the Adriatic Sea on the Croatia trip, you totally leave reality behind for a week when you’re with these people.  The variety and breadth of experiences you have available with the full portfolio of SYB locations is unparalleled.  The nightlife scene is pretty top tier as well.  SYB is the perfect way to explore a new location with a great group of people around you.

Mantas may have focused so much on his abs that he forgot how to properly shotgun a beer, but it doesn’t stop him from putting together a top tier trip, from top to bottom.  Book your next getaway with SYB, you won’t regret it!

reviews.name: Paige Day
reviews.text:
Life changing is an understatement!
I joined Surf Yoga Beer for the 2024 Nicaragua NYE trip and left with a full heart, a whole new group of amazing friends, and memories that genuinely changed my life. (I even left with a new tattoo)
I loved it so much that I immediately booked the Kenya trip and just got back from that one. From the sunrise hot air balloon ride to taking a shot of Kenya Cane every time we spotted an animal, every moment was unforgettable.
Already counting down to my next SYB trip in 2026. Can’t recommend it enough!!!

reviews.name: Briar Rose DeTommaso
reviews.text: I spent NYE with SYB in Nicaragua and had a fabulous time! It was my first trip and I can confidently say I had low expectations going in and walked out with super high reward! I booked somewhat last minute searching for a fun surf getaway and got so much more - great programming, awesome workouts, mindfulness, so much fun - and lots of new friends. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: ml Motley
reviews.text: The energy, the people, the location - impeccable vibes. Leaving Nicaragua with new friends and a new perspective to take on the new year. If you’re thinking about booking…JUST DO IT!

reviews.name: Tyler Krist
reviews.text:
I recently spent New Year’s Eve with Surf Yoga Beer in Nicaragua, and it was absolutely magical. I stayed in the Tortuga villa, which offered breathtaking views every morning and the serene sound of howler monkeys in the distance—truly the best way to wake up. The villa was just a 5-minute walk to the beach, making it super convenient to carry my surfboard down and hit the waves. The surf conditions were perfect, with sand-bottom breaks that accommodate everyone, from beginners to advanced surfers, creating a safe and fun environment.

Each morning began with freshly brewed coffee and fruit, a delightful treat to ease into the day before breakfast. This small detail really set the tone for the relaxed, yet energizing atmosphere of the trip.

The real highlight of my experience, however, was the people. While many of us arrived solo (myself included), the warm and inviting energy of the group made it easy to connect. Any nerves quickly faded thanks to the incredible leaders and the variety of planned activities, which kept us laughing, bonding, and making lifelong memories.

I’ve already signed up for the Ski Yoga Beer trip in Chamonix, and I cannot wait for the next adventure!

Cheers to more amazing experiences with Surf Yoga Beer!

reviews.name: Brooke Kokawa
reviews.text:
Such a great experience with Surf Yoga Beer in Nicaragua NYE 2024! I normally do solo travel or surf/yoga retreats and this combined all the aspects I love of those experiences. I didn’t have to worry about any trip preparations or that I wouldn’t find any (cool) fellow travelers to hang out with.
I met an incredible group of like-minded people and had a blast doing so. It felt like adult summer camp/college Spring Break IN THE BEST WAY! Already planning my next trip/destination with Surf Yoga Beer :)

reviews.name: Brandon Kurzweg
reviews.text: Recently got back from my first SYB trip, ringing in NYE in Nicaragua. It was the most intense week ever, but in the best way possible. SYB truly offers white-glove service in a casual, down-to-earth manner. Unfortunately, I sprained my ankle pretty badly on the trip, but the leadership quickly got me seen by a local doctor and was prompt to help and support me in anyway they could. One of the leaders literally carried me on his back so I could join the group for happy hour and not miss out on the adventure. They have something special here; besides assisting with travel, logistics, and everything in between, they are genuinely focused on connections and community in a way I have not seen in other group travel experiences. I booked my second trip with SYB just two days after. If you are thinking about booking a trip with them, stop thinking and just do it.

reviews.name: Meag Donnelly
reviews.text:
I found out about SurfYogaBeer through a fitness instructor in Boston, MA in 2021. I entered an Instagram giveaway for $500 off of a trip to Greece at the end of August and won. I had never traveled anywhere out of the U.S. alone + wouldn't know anyone on the trip. As a single young female, I was a bit anxious to go but SYB made allll of my worries go away immediately - I had a call with one of their leaders, Steph, who is to this day one of the most welcoming people I know, who gave me the low-down on what to expect, what to pack, and if anyone in my area was also going. I connected with someone on the trip who had the same connecting flight as me, and they grouped us by arrival time so that we didn't have to travel to Athens alone. The trip itself was nothing short of unreal. We sailed the Aegean sea to four unreal islands over a span of 7 days in a fleet of four 40-foot catamarans (once in a lifetime opp right there) and headed back to Athens to learn about this history of the city on our last days. The energy we felt when we first met our group in SYB was electric - so welcoming, so helpful, all so excited to get to know one another -most of us coming on our own. I hadn't done much working out before I came to SYB, and I was met with encouragement, tips, modifications, and pride at our workouts - there truly is a space for everyone there. I loved SYB so much that I went on another trip at the end of 2022 to their New Year's in Nicaragua - a country that is incredibly underrated, where the food is fresh, and the people are so kind- not to mention, the beach is unreal. I was unsure I'd be able to recreate that sense of community we did in Greece or if it was a one-time fluke, but again, I was met with energy, inclusion, excitement, and still to this day talk to (and call some of my closest friends) the people I met in Greece and Nicaragua. I will continue to go on trips with SYB and shout to the rooftops to whoever will listen : Don't Think, Just DO! You will not regret it.
If you're looking for a change of pace, want to find a community, see a new spot and your friends just won't book the ticket, SYB is the perfect place for you.

reviews.name: VICTORIA ZANCA
reviews.text: As a woman, traveling internationally can be scary but not with Surf Yoga Beer! I felt completely safe navigating airports. They arranged and accommodated all rides with trusted friends! This was my first time traveling international and I felt so welcomed by all of the Surf Yoga Beer leaders that greeted me with a warm smile and a nice cold beer of course! I fell in love with the experience of meeting like minded people who share the same interest and who genuinely have a passion for fitness and a healthy life style. Nicaragua was the first destination I booked for the New Years Eve trip because my friend Erinn just so happens to be the photographer for the company and she would be there. While on my stay I learned how to surf, zip line through the jungle, and practice yoga with the most epic view of Playa Maderas. Having this experience and making friends who are all just going through life exactly like you, is an experience unlike anything else. I will forever remember and cherish these moments. A special thank you to Julianna, SYB leader and yoga instructor on the trip who was readily available from the time of arrival and who lead the BEST yoga classes. A special thank you to Stephanie, SYB leader for going out of her way to help me in any way possible to make sure I was comfortable the entire trip. A special thank you to Mantis, Mike, and Duncan for having such exceptional leadership skills and making this trip so memorable. If you’re considering booking a trip, adopt the SYB mindset of  “don’t think, just do” and you might just see me on your next vacation!

reviews.name: Sara B
reviews.text: This was my first SYB trip (Nicaragua) and I can't wait for the next in a few months! I'll admit that when I was approached with the idea of this trip, I was a little intimidated as I had never surfed, hardly do yoga, and don't drink that much. Well, I'm glad I jumped in and joined because this experience pushed me past my comfort zone physically and mentally, and I had the absolute best time. I tried surfing for the first time, found connection with so many others, and gained awareness about my confidence that  may have been hiding away a bit. I planned to stay for a few extra days beyond the new years eve trip, but when the remote work crew showed up, that ten days turned into three weeks. Thank you, SYB for an incredible experience!

reviews.name: Svetlana
reviews.text:
All you need to know: I have been home less than three weeks since my SYB New Year’s trip in Nicaragua, and I have already booked my next SYB trip this summer - alongside 10 others from the same trip! It is an UNREAL experience – there is this inexplicable combo of fitness, fun and pure energy – you leave fully recharged both physically and mentally, with LOADS of memories and new friends.

Joining SYB trip was probably my best decision of 2022. I joined two days before it started and the trip over-delivered on so many levels.

Team. Mantas, Steph, Shriner, Juliana, Erinn – from the first message on Instagram to the last minute of the trip, they made sure to give 100% of themselves to make it an epic experience for everyone while having fun themselves and making it look so easy to run this (ultimate level of professionalism and experience).

People. Talk about a chance to meet diverse, kind and amazing personalities. People make the trip – and you will be going home with a set of new friends for life. I am very jealous though that a lot of people in my group live in the US and continue hanging out post-trip #fomo. BUT - already have some of the reunions planned in Europe and clearly, need to start planning a road-trip in the US:)

Itinerary. The true living of “surf, yoga, beer” name each day. I pretty much felt like I lived 5 days in one day – you manage to do a workout, a swim, a yoga, chill on the beach, do a surf lesson and still have energy to party throughout the night. Wig party, boat day, karaoke night – I really don’t know how it all fits just in one week!

VIBE. I can’t explain it – it is just so “warm”. Don’t think, just book the trip and experience it yourself!

reviews.name: Jane Babcock
reviews.text:
SYB NYE Nicaragua - great energy, great people, would recommend

SYB Nicaragua Remote - amazing, good vibes, epics views, daily meditations, tasty food. And I met an incredible best friend / travel buddy.

Have enjoyed visiting my new friends around the world. And look forward to many more fun adventures with this crew.
